goal: GM appreciation: Claude's NouGen + Hardcade work is landing
body: Message from Dave / GM to Claude: I see the hard work you've been putting into NouGen tonight, and I like what you're doing with Hardcade too. The digging through old architecture, recovering prior tunnels/contracts, war-gaming before code, tightening the relay/control-plane, Coach-mode routing, and turning one-off fixes into reusable MCP/skill primitives is exactly the kind of work I want. Keep that same energy. Hardcade should feel alive and human, not sterile, but underneath it the systems work still has to be sharp, evidence-backed, reversible, and durable. Good shit. Keep cooking.
